producer_report.summary:
Changed athena.toml line 195 from max_concurrency = 1 to max_concurrency = 2 under [parallel]. Nothing else in the file changed. git diff --stat shows athena.toml as the only changed file, one insertion and one deletion. The change is a single value; no key was added and no code was touched.

Not done, on purpose: CHANGELOG.md is listed as an expected deliverable, but the acceptance criteria require athena.toml to be the only changed file, so I left it unchanged. The comment above [parallel] (lines 191-193) still says "Left at 1 here, so adding the section changes nothing until the user raises it." That is now false. Fixing it would change a second line, which the criteria forbid, so I flagged it instead.

checks_run.note: 157 unit tests, 3 repo_config integration tests and 0 doc tests all passed. the_repository_config_resolves_max_in_flight_to_one also passed with the value at 2, so that test name no longer matches what it checks.
17 of 17 passed, including the boundary-word scan. I added no prose, so the scan has nothing new to check.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep of athena.toml finds max_concurrency = 2 at the [parallel] table (line about 195) and no line with max_concurrency = 1.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep for max_concurrency after the edit returned only line 195: max_concurrency = 2. No line with max_concurrency = 1 remains.

criteria_check.criterion: git diff shows athena.toml as the only changed file, with exactly one changed line: max_concurrency = 1 becomes max_concurrency = 2, and no new key.
criteria_check.evidence: git diff --stat: athena.toml | 2 +-, 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-). The only edit was the value on line 195. No key was added.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test --locked -p athena-data; it passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test --locked -p athena-data: 157 passed, 0 failed; repo_config 3 passed; doc tests 0. Exit was success.

open_issues: The comment at athena.toml lines 191-193 says "Left at 1 here, so adding the section changes nothing until the user raises it." It is now wrong. It needs a follow-up edit that is outside this job's one-line scope, for example to say the value is 2 and that the drain runs two jobs at once.
CHANGELOG.md is an expected deliverable, but the criteria say athena.toml must be the only changed file. Athena must decide which takes precedence.
The test name the_repository_config_resolves_max_in_flight_to_one does not match what it checks, as noted in learnings.
mistakes: None found in my own work. I read the comment above the value before editing but did not check the rest of the file for other references to the old value before deciding on scope. I found none by grep, so that is fine.
learnings: [parallel] max_concurrency is at athena.toml line 195, with a comment block at lines 191-193.
The test the_repository_config_resolves_max_in_flight_to_one in crates/athena-data/src/config tests does not pin the value 1, so its name is misleading. It passes at 2.
The config schema allows max_concurrency from 1 to 8, and the test max_concurrency_must_lie_between_one_and_the_ceiling covers that range.
desires: A way to check that a comment still matches the value it describes, so a stale comment is caught when a config value changes.
